The '''2015–16 Texas A&M Aggies men's basketball team''' represented [[Texas A&M University]] in the [[2015–16 NCAA Division I men's basketball season|2015–16 college basketball season]]. The team's head coach was [[Billy Kennedy (basketball)|Billy Kennedy]], in his fifth season. The team played their home games at [[Reed Arena]] in [[College Station, Texas]] and was in its fourth season as a member of the [[Southeastern Conference]]. They finished the season 28–9, 13–5 in SEC play to win a share of the SEC regular season championship. They defeated [[2015–16 Florida Gators men's basketball team|Florida]] and [[2015–16 LSU Tigers basketball team|LSU]] to advance to the championship game of the [[2016 SEC men's basketball tournament|SEC tournament]], where they lost to [[2015–16 Kentucky Wildcats men's basketball team|Kentucky]]. They received an at-large bid to the [[2016 NCAA Division I men's basketball tournament|NCAA tournament]], where they defeated [[2015–16 Green Bay Phoenix men's basketball team|Green Bay]] and [[2015–16 Northern Iowa Panthers men's basketball team|Northern Iowa]] to advance to the Sweet Sixteen, where they lost to [[2015–16 Oklahoma Sooners men's basketball team|Oklahoma]].

==Previous season==
The team had a 21–12 (11–7 in conference play) record and entered the [[2015 SEC men's basketball tournament|SEC Tournament]] as the 5th seed after losing two games to end conference play, where they lost to [[2014–15 Auburn Tigers men's basketball team|Auburn]]. The team earned an NIT bid as a No. 2 seed (despite making noise for a bid to the NCAA Tournament, which was silenced after a losing skid at the end of the season) and lost in the second round of the NIT To [[2014–15 Louisiana Tech Bulldogs basketball team|Louisiana Tech]] after beating [[2014–15 Montana Grizzlies basketball team|Montana]] in the first round.
